detailed_description: GIF Splitter extracts each frame of an animated GIF into a PNG. Upload a GIF, the tool parses it with gifuct-js and decompresses every frame at its original dimensions to a canvas, then renders all frames as a numbered thumbnail grid. By default every frame is selected; click thumbnails to toggle, or use Select All / Deselect All. Click Download Selected to package the chosen PNGs into a single ZIP file produced with JSZip. The tool keeps the original frame size and exports PNG only; it does not output JPEG, change frame rate, resize frames, edit timing, or download a single frame on its own.
usage_steps: Click the upload area and select an animated GIF
Wait for the spinner while frames are decoded with gifuct-js
Review the numbered thumbnail grid and the total/selected frame counts
Click thumbnails to toggle them, or use Select All or Deselect All
Click Download Selected to download the chosen PNGs in a single ZIP
Click Clear to remove the GIF and start over
usage_examples: Pull a single hero frame out of an animated meme to use as a thumbnail PNG
Export a few keyframes from a reference animation by toggling specific thumbnails before downloading
Save every frame of a short loop as PNGs to import into another editor as a sprite sheet source
Inspect each frame in the grid to find which step of an animation has a glitch
